value.rationale: Exact natural all-modulus deterministic memory requirement under an important local run constraint and a global scattered-subsequence statistic. It proves the full modular counter orbit survives no-11 avoidance and that every orbit point has precisely two Boolean-distinguishable boundary classes, including a parity-sensitive factor-of-two reduction for even moduli. This structurally motivated infinite family goes beyond a product upper bound and has direct finite-state decoder relevance.
